name: function-signature-test-d3becf86ae/function-signatures-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature

Invocations / Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for function calls when the callee has an atomic function type with a known parameter signature.

Invocations / Named and default arguments: Named arguments and omitted defaultable arguments are supported for method calls and client remote method call actions only when the receiver type has one positive object atom.
Object/class definitions: Supports included-record-param, rest-param and defaultable-param in methods
Expressions: Call; Method call; Trap expression; Error constructor; New expression; List constructor; Mapping constructor; Type test expression
Statements: Panic; If/else; Return; Local variable declarations
Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: array:length; value:toString and value:toBalString
reason: The asserted results exercise supported positional/named/default/rest argument binding, array rest spreads, nil/union defaults, concrete-class initialization and methods, first-class rest-parameter functions, and trapping a panic. Function targets have known signatures and method receivers are concrete classes. Array/tuple indexing and lengths, arithmetic/string concatenation, equality/type tests and error construction used by assertions are supported. No essential construct violates an invocation or langlib restriction.
test_design_notes: The two first-class-function tests assert returned values; the final test asserts that trap converts the panic to an error.
